wiki.title: Cactus Jake
wiki.text:
Cactus Jake is an enemy NPC boss that can be found in the Sandscale Oasis, located in Sunstone Valley. He is the leader of a band of cactus outlaws.

Sandscale Oasis
Cactus Jake and his Cactus Outlaws have taken over the manguana watering hole. While lacking hydration, the Sandscale manguana tribe have become aggressive and began attacking travelers and residents.

TCG
220px|right

On March 21, 2013, a Trading Card Game Hero card was introduced based on Cactus Jake in the Series 5 Rumbledome! Expansion. The card's ID is 5U1.
